summary: Fixed aset CSV header error: parser now auto-detects comma/semicolon/tab delimiters (Excel ID), skips Excel sep= preamble, normalizes encoding/BOM, and shows clearer error with detected headers. Added tests for semicolon and sep= CSVs; 9 import tests passed.
